name: Ni Shi Yige Maoxian Zhe
source:
You are an adventurer came to a new town. After a short rest at the hotel, you come to the adventurer union to pick up your first wage slave... I mean, your first task as a hero.

[Translated from [url=https://leothelionel.itch.io/thehumanheart]Itch.io[/url]]
